* Booster Cards 🚀
  * You can now boost your MLB player cards for a day with booster cards.
When you boost a player, their earnings get multiplied for that day.
Each play pack you open now contains one booster card.
The booster card rarities and multipliers are identical to play, player and team cards.
  * For example, say you have a Rare 1.6x player card.
You then apply a 2x Epic booster card to the player.
This will increase earnings for that day to 3.2x for that player 📈
  * Booster cards are single-use, so choose wisely.
  * All packs contain one booster card.
Starter packs contain a common or uncommon booster.
General and Yesterday packs contain a booster with the same rarity as the highest rarity card.
  * NBA packs also contain booster cards and can be used in the upcoming season.
NFL packs will contain booster cards when they launch.
